against.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

against.head: Below its averages
against.text: Price has slipped below both its 50-day and 200-day averages.
against.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

against.head: Weekly chart: rolling over
against.text: The 30-week average has flattened after a long rise, and price has slipped under it.
against.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the January breakout level, the open gap of Nov 9 and the March breakout level, where 7 levels (2 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the March high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: Next support −7.1% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −7.1% below (1.9 ATR): the Mar 20 low, the Mar 9 low and the Jan 28 low.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.
